verdict.rationale: Linear documents building agents that investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback. Inside the product, Loops let you define recurring agent jobs in plain language and trigger them on a schedule or on workspace events, and shared skills turn personal workflows into team process. A developer agents platform also lets you build your own agent app with assignable and mentionable scopes and connect it to the workspace. Missing for 10: detail on in-product agent configuration (instructions, tool or model selection, permissions per agent), clarity that fully custom agents can be built without external hosting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
